raw: “I felt sad when I said goodbye to my foster dog. Its blanket was folded by the front door, and the new owner’s leash was on its collar. I remember looking at that leash and thinking, this is really goodbye. Then my attention went back to the blanket—something so familiar, just folded up by the door. It’s that little detail that stays with me. I knew it was a foster dog, but knowing that didn’t make saying goodbye feel any easier.”
